sentences.en: I go to work by train.
The cart is pulled by a horse.
The ship goes across the sea.
The boat is small. It is on the river.
The plane is like a bird in the sky.
sentences.zh: 飞机像天空中的一只鸟。

sentences.en: The wheel on the train goes round and round.
sentences.zh: 火车上的轮子不停地转。

sentences.en: What is your transport to school?
sentences.zh: 你用什么交通工具去学校？

sentences.en: The engine makes the train go.
I travel to another town by bus.
sentences.zh: 我坐公交去另一个城镇。

sentences.en: Do you have a ticket for the train?
The flight from here to London is long.
sentences.zh: 从这里到伦敦的飞行很长。

sentences.en: The sail on the ship was white.
Steam came out of the engine of the train.
sentences.zh: 蒸汽从火车的引擎中冒出。

sentences.en: The rail was long and straight.
The cart was full of grain from the farm.
sentences.zh: 马车上装满了从农场来的谷物。

sentences.en: The carriage was pulled by two horses.
The bell of the train made a loud sound.
sentences.zh: 火车的铃铛发出了很大的声音。
